inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] ONE UNINTERRUPTED EIGHT-SECOND photographed live-action cinema shot, developing from this EXACT approved first-frame picture. The short black-haired fighter at LEFT is HIEI, with the same angular face, one vertical violet forehead eye, torn dark cotton sleeveless top, pale waist sash, dark trousers and boots. His already extended RIGHT hand owns the black fire. The taller blond fighter at RIGHT middle distance is ZERU, same navy short-sleeved T-shirt, ivory loose trousers and black boots. Retain both identities, relative scale, anatomy and costumes from the photograph. Exactly these two fighters, then only Hiei after Zeru is consumed. The enormous serpentine dragon already coiled overhead is BLACK FLAME with narrow violet burning edges and a clear long head, no solid scales or wings. Preserve its ownership by Hiei's RIGHT hand.

The entire shot occurs on the SAME open tiled tournament platform visible in the approved image. It is a SINGLE FIXED THREE-DIMENSIONAL SET: pale cracked tiles, low distant perimeter retaining wall, arena seating above that wall, large curved stadium canopy and cloudy sky. These structures have their EXACT initial size and location for all eight seconds. No wall rises out of the floor. No new wall or barrier appears behind Zeru. No slab, shield, building, platform, crater or huge stone block is created. The distant perimeter wall always stays distant with the seating visible above it, and the open space immediately behind Zeru remains open. Do not bring the background wall forward or turn it into a tall close wall. This shot shows the incineration itself; it does NOT need to depict the later canonical wall silhouette. Avoid trying to invent a surface to carry a silhouette.

Keep the camera in the inherited low three-quarter SOUTH-side viewpoint. Make only a modest physical lateral truck to the RIGHT, less than one normal human step, and a small pullback over the shot so Hiei's extended right hand, the gap between the fighters and Zeru's torso remain visible together. The small actual translation changes the perspective of the nearby tile joints against distant spectators. Maintain Hiei at LEFT and Zeru at RIGHT throughout. Do not pass around Hiei's back, cross the fight axis, whip-pan, tilt into sky, change lens, rapidly zoom or replace the set. Camera supports the attack rather than redirecting the location.

0.00–2.00 seconds: Leave the first picture immediately. Hiei turns his already extended RIGHT palm toward Zeru, brings his weight into his legs and slightly rotates the right shoulder, not swapping arms or turning his entire back to camera. The airborne black-flame dragon coils tighten and its head turns sharply toward Zeru. Hair, ragged cotton edges and the black flame move independently. Zeru perceives this, stiffens and makes one short bracing step backward with actual foot support. The ordinary orange fire on Zeru's fist flickers against the approaching violet light. Black fire belongs only to Hiei.

2.00–5.40 seconds: Hiei plants the forward foot and thrusts his RIGHT arm firmly toward Zeru. ONE black-fire dragon surges out along the connection to that hand and traverses the clear space LEFT TO RIGHT at normal forceful action speed, trailing a long serpentine torrent of black flame and violet edges. Keep the dragon's head recognizable until it reaches its target. Its head reaches Zeru's CHEST first. Only after the visible arrival does Zeru's torso jolt back and his boots scrape a short distance, without flying through the arena. He raises his forearms too late. The black infernal fire envelops Zeru's whole body from that contact point. His ivory trousers and navy shirt are briefly legible inside the flame silhouette, then his entire figure disintegrates into hot ash, not just becomes hidden behind a smoke cloud. His head, torso and legs are all gone by the end of this interval. No blood, gore, exposed bone or intact corpse. The dragon burns through and loses its body into ragged turbulent black fire as Zeru is consumed, without transforming into a solid beam, a snake of flesh or a ring-shaped portal. Integrated heat shimmer and violet reflections hit the SAME real arena tiles and fabric, with only a limited dust-and-ash plume around the point of impact. Effects must not occupy the entire frame or hide the spatial relationship.

5.40–8.00 seconds: The black flame turbulence breaks apart and the ash falls, clearly exposing EMPTY OPEN AIR exactly where Zeru stood. Nobody comes out of the smoke; no replacement fighter, wall, stone slab, upright object or human-shaped cloud appears there. The original low distant retaining wall and seating remain unchanged and visible through the thinning air. The only new marks are small charred smears and scattered ash on the EXISTING FLOOR TILES under Zeru's former feet. Keep the camera in the same low SOUTH view. Hiei eases his RIGHT arm downward with a tight pained breath, looks at his exhausted hand, and takes one small physically supported recovery step as the last violet fire extinguishes around his wrist. His torn top stays torn; do not heal fabric, invent later dragon tattoos or add a new outfit. Natural human skin and hair, grounded boots, subtle cloth inertia. Keep active falling ash, wind and Hiei's reaction through the final frame, without a long held pose, loop, freeze or slow motion.

Use the exact approved tangible photographed appearance: natural pores and sweat, individual hair strands, weighted cotton and cloth weave, coherent light and contact shadows. Preserve Hiei's face and Zeru's blond hair until the contact. Do not blend their identities, swap arms or powers, add people, extra limbs, subtitles, logos or attack-name text. Do not turn the human actors into game renders, anime, waxy CG faces or plastic costumes.

overall_soundscape: Native synchronized diegetic sound only: distant nonverbal stadium ambience, boots bracing and scraping, cloth, a low rising flame pressure, one rushing black-fire release, one strong impact when the dragon reaches Zeru, fire combustion and ash falling. After contact, the roar dies down and Hiei's breath remains. No language, speech, invented shout, narration, singing, chant, audience words or cloned actor voice. Preserve the generated native soundtrack for review.
